Your depot average is lying to you

Northwick Yard reads the three timestamps your handhelds already collect and shows you the handovers that actually cost you a shift.

Book a walkthrough

What it does

No new hardware, no new fields for drivers to fill in, and nothing that asks a yard supervisor to change how they work. It reads what is already there.

Reads the gaps

Seal scan to weighbridge slip to sign-off. The waiting between them is the measurement.

Names the outliers

The four handovers a week that run past three hours, with the depot and shift attached.

Leaves the average alone

You still get it. It is simply never the headline number on any screen we build.

How a week looks

A supervisor opens one page at the start of a shift. It lists the handovers still open from yesterday, and nothing else.

Monday

Two trailers at Carrowmoor waiting on a weighbridge slip that was never scanned.

Wednesday

A seal discrepancy called in eleven minutes after the driver had already left the yard.

Friday

Nothing open. The page says so in one line and the supervisor closes it again.

What it will not do

It does not score drivers, it does not produce a league table of depots, and it does not send anybody an email at six in the morning. Every one of those was asked for and turned down.

See it against one depot's data

A fortnight of real handovers, read in an afternoon, with no integration work.
